name: Body-Dominant Engulfing with Close-Strength Exit
note: An engulfing bar that has to earn the name three ways at once: its body engulfs the prior body (open inside the prior close, close beyond the prior open), that body is body_ratio times the prior body, and the body is at least body_frac of its own range while the range itself is at least rng_atr of ATR(14). The context gate asks that weak_k of the previous weak_n bars closed below their own prior close, so the bar arrives after real one-sided pressure rather than at random. Reversal is NOT assumed -- Bulkowski's outside-day data has these continuing 63% of the time -- so the trade is simply taken in the direction of the engulfing body. The exit is the real idea: a close-strength stop that liquidates on the first decisive close-against-the-position wide bar, CLV = ((close-low)-(high-close))/(high-low) <= clv_exit with the range at least clv_rng_atr of ATR -- bar geometry, not a price level and not an indicator. The engulfing bar's own low (minus low_pad) is also honoured as a stop inside exit_signal; the 3-ATR target is left to the shared execution grid, which sweeps 1 to 4.
source: Bulkowski, T., thepatternsite.com/OutsideDays.html -- an engulfing bar is an outside day with body constraints, and Bulkowski's data show outside days act as a CONTINUATION 63% of the time in bull markets with up breakouts (average rise 10%, 32% break-even failure rate, rank 6 of 23 small patterns), which is why this rule does not assume reversal. Null-result context: Marshall, Young and Rose (2006), Journal of Banking & Finance 30(8), 2303-2323.

def family_init(ctx):
    import indicators as I
    bars = ctx.bars
    n = len(bars)
    o = [float(b["o"]) for b in bars]
    h = [float(b["h"]) for b in bars]
    l = [float(b["l"]) for b in bars]
    c = [float(b["c"]) for b in bars]
    at = I.compute("atr", bars, period=max(2, int(ctx.p.eng_atr_n)))["atr"]

    ratio = float(ctx.p.body_ratio)
    frac = float(ctx.p.body_frac)
    rmin = float(ctx.p.rng_atr)
    wk = int(ctx.p.weak_k)
    wn = max(1, int(ctx.p.weak_n))

    # how many of the last wn bars closed below / above their own prior close
    dn = [0] * (n + 1)
    up = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(n):
        d = 1 if (i > 0 and c[i] < c[i - 1]) else 0
        u = 1 if (i > 0 and c[i] > c[i - 1]) else 0
        dn[i + 1] = dn[i] + d
        up[i + 1] = up[i] + u

    sig = [0] * n
    for i in range(max(2, wn), n):
        a = at[i]
        if not a or a <= 0.0:
            continue
        rg = h[i] - l[i]
        if rg <= 0.0:
            continue
        if rg < rmin * a:
            continue
        b0 = abs(c[i] - o[i])
        b1 = abs(c[i - 1] - o[i - 1])
        if b1 <= 0.0 or b0 < ratio * b1 or b0 < frac * rg:
            continue
        if c[i] > o[i] and c[i - 1] < o[i - 1] \
                and o[i] <= c[i - 1] and c[i] > o[i - 1]:
            if wk <= 0 or (dn[i] - dn[i - wn]) >= wk:
                sig[i] = 1
        elif c[i] < o[i] and c[i - 1] > o[i - 1] \
                and o[i] >= c[i - 1] and c[i] < o[i - 1]:
            if wk <= 0 or (up[i] - up[i - wn]) >= wk:
                sig[i] = -1

    clv = [None] * n
    for i in range(n):
        rg = h[i] - l[i]
        if rg > 0.0:
            clv[i] = ((c[i] - l[i]) - (h[i] - c[i])) / rg

    ctx.sig = ctx.series(sig, "engulf")
    ctx.clv = ctx.series(clv, "clv")
    ctx.eatr = ctx.series(at, "eng_atr")


def signal(ctx, i):
    return int(ctx.sig[i])


def exit_signal(ctx, i):
    """Close-strength stop. One decisive wide bar closing against the position
    ends it, whatever the price level has done -- and the engulfing bar's own
    low is honoured as the structural stop."""
    if not ctx.positions:
        return False
    e = min(p["entry_i"] for p in ctx.positions)
    long_ = ctx.positions[0]["side"] == "long"
    k = e - 1                      # the engulfing bar: the signal, not the fill
    if k >= 0:
        pad = float(ctx.p.low_pad)
        if long_ and ctx.l[i] < ctx.l[k] - pad:
            return True
        if not long_ and ctx.h[i] > ctx.h[k] + pad:
            return True
    v = ctx.clv[i]
    if v is None:
        return False
    a = ctx.eatr[i]
    if not a or a <= 0.0:
        return False
    if (ctx.h[i] - ctx.l[i]) < float(ctx.p.clv_rng_atr) * a:
        return False
    thr = float(ctx.p.clv_exit)
    return v <= thr if long_ else v >= -thr
